details.description: Nova is a general-purpose speech-to-text model from Deepgram's first Nova-tier release, used for transcribing everyday audio. Deepgram's Model Options page describes the Nova tier as trained on over 100 domains and 47 billion tokens. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Nova under "Legacy Models", meaning it has been superseded by the Nova-2 and Nova-3 model generations.
advantages: Trained on over 100 domains and 47 billion tokens, per Deepgram's Model Options documentation.
disadvantages: Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Nova under "Legacy Models", superseded by the Nova-2 and Nova-3 generations.

Deepgram's language documentation lists support only for English (en, en-US, en-AU, en-GB, en-NZ, en-IN), Spanish (es, es-419), and a Latin-script transliteration of Hindi (hi-Latn), far fewer languages than Nova-3.
No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures for this model were found on Deepgram's current documentation.

notes: Deepgram's language table lists Hindi only as 'hi-Latn' (a Latin-script transliteration variant), so I recorded the language as Hindi rather than a separate transliteration entry. No WER or other benchmark figures specific to plain 'Nova' were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. The catalog carries no deprecation_date, though Deepgram's own docs mark this model legacy.
